items.title: Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective
items.author: Scott Young
items.description: We rarely notice what's closest to us. Perspective is hard to gain, but it is worth cultivating. Here's how. The post Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective appeared first on Scott H Young .
items.summary: An old fish swims by two young fish and says, “Morning boys, how’s the water?” After he passes by, one young fish looks at the other and says, “What the heck is water?” The joke points to an important truth: we rarely notice what’s closest to us. The traits we have that are most obvious to others are often invisible to us.

Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages: a full-step model first consolidates capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, then serves as a fixed teacher for step distillation.

items.title: Converting Documents to Markdown With MarkItDown
items.description: Learn how to use MarkItDown to convert Excel files, PDFs, and images into clean Markdown that's ready for LLMs and AI workflows.
items.summary: The MarkItDown library lets you quickly turn PDFs, Office files, images, HTML, and URLs into LLM-ready Markdown. In this video course, you’ll install MarkItDown, use it in Python code to convert and batch-process documents, connect it to AI clients through its MCP server, and see where it falls short compared to tools like Pandoc.
